features: Replace the on-demand Groq/GPT-OSS research path with one Tavily Basic Search request per clicked S3/S0.5/S1 symbol; Full Analysis and Auto Batch remain completely independent from news lookup
Tavily search stays broad (topic=news, time_range=week, max_results=10); Cloudflare Worker JS performs deterministic Hard Gate filtering after retrieval instead of over-constraining the search API
Add a centralized company alias layer for English names, tickers and common Traditional-Chinese names such as Microsoft/MSFT/微軟, NVIDIA/NVDA/輝達, TSMC/TSM/台積電, SK hynix/SK海力士

Hard Gate rejects quote/profile/index pages, social/community sources, old-event republishing, price/valuation commentary, law-firm deadline solicitations, institutional-holding/insider stories, analyst-consensus articles and title/body feed mismatches
Only up to 3 verified company-event sources are written to each research item; if none survive, the result explicitly says no qualifying major company news instead of padding results
Successful Tavily results keep the existing 24H immutable R2 cache behavior and are stored in research/us-stock/cache.json plus research/us-stock/latest.json
Provider migration invalidates old Groq cache entries on the client/Worker so the next click refreshes them through Tavily instead of keeping stale provider output
Cloudflare Worker now requires TAVILY_API_KEY as the news-search secret; the key never reaches GitHub Pages
US-stock S3 / S0.5 / S1 cards now expose an on-demand breathing 🔎 等待查詢 capsule; no news search runs until the user explicitly clicks that symbol
R2 research/us-stock/latest.json persists across page reloads and remains downloadable through ⬇ 新聞 JSON
Add mixed verdict support and human labels for beat/miss/inline and raised/maintained/lowered
Manual-review means grounded search completed but output format was imperfect; the UI explains this without exposing raw JSON
Transient RPM/TPM/unknown-429/5xx/network failures retry only the current symbol once; a second failure stops the batch
Existing 24H cache semantics remain shared across AUTO and MANUAL US-stock analyses
Local quick-search box filters cards instantly by symbol, S-state, sector, underlying ticker, company name, or research summary without API calls
A symbol already researched within 24H is reused as CACHE_24H even if it drops out and re-enters S3/S0.5/S1
Research scope is restricted to 7D company catalysts, 14D analyst/SEC/regulatory events, last earnings <=90D, next earnings <=30D, and directly relevant industry events
Research excludes social rumors, price prediction articles, technical analysis, options-flow noise, and unrelated macro news
R2 stores one research/us-stock/cache.json and one research/us-stock/latest.json; both are overwritten rather than accumulating per run
Cloudflare Worker merges Pionex trade-time status + Auto Batch lock + US-stock research R2 endpoints
Telegram completion notification for manual Full Analysis, labeled as manual and selected market (Crypto or US-stock)
Telegram completion notification for scheduled Auto Batch, labeled as automatic and pair / 21:31 US-stock-only mode
Telegram notification includes Taiwan time, analyzed symbol count, and S3/S0.5/S1/S2/S0/OTHER breadth counts
Telegram Bot token is read only from GitHub Actions secret TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN; chat ID is fixed to 1880226268
Telegram delivery failure does not turn a successful market analysis into a failed analysis run
Cloudflare Cron Auto Batch: every 4 hours at Taiwan 00:01/04:01/08:01/12:01/16:01/20:01 runs Crypto then US-stock sequentially
Taiwan 21:31 Auto Batch runs US-stock only
Website polls global Auto Batch status; Full Analysis button becomes dark ⚡🚫 and disabled while scheduled analysis is active
Manual analysis remains market-specific outside Auto Batch: selected Crypto runs only Crypto; selected US-stock runs only US-stock
Auto jobs share each market concurrency lane with manual jobs, preventing same-market overlap; queue:max prevents pending-run replacement
Auto Batch status is stored in one overwritten R2 object automation/latest/status.json with stale-lock protection
Fix sample-tier denominator: use Active Champion training.cases_count and repaint cards after Champion metadata loads
Sample-dot tier color is also written inline so stale CSS cache cannot hide the tier color
Only the sample dot changes color by sample tier (SSR/SR/R/N/C) while the sample capsule text stays unchanged
TradingView-like chart crosshair with dashed X/Y guides
Crosshair date label and live Y-axis price label
Tiny-price chart axis uses zero-count exponent notation such as 0.29045e-5
Secondary summary pill row removed; top-right filters remain
Quick stats use a subtle unified capsule
Existing probability hover card preserved unchanged
HUD slanted segmented analysis energy bar with subtle breathing glow
S-state palette: S3 yellow, S0.5 purple, S1 blue, S2 green, S0 white, OTHER dark
Card ordering priority: S3 > S0.5 > S1 > S2 > S0 > OTHER
US-stock/RWA cards show live Pionex PERP TRADING or OFFLINE status
Market status refreshes every 60 seconds without requiring Full Analysis
Green trading badge has a subtle breathing live indicator; offline badge stays muted
Replace high-weight common/symbols status calls with one PERP tickers request
US-stock badge is based on ticker freshness (<=5 minutes = TRADING)
Last known status is served if Pionex temporarily returns HTTP 429
Retire Cloudflare-to-Pionex REST market-status proxy
Browser connects directly to Pionex public futures DEPTH WebSocket
Activity classification uses actual order-book signature changes
Statuses: WATCHING / TRADING(price activity) / OFFLINE(price static)
Subscriptions throttled to 280ms intervals per connection
Remove global NYSE session gate for Pionex RWA contracts
Browser directly queries Pionex PERP common/symbols status=ALL
Per-contract TRADING/OFFLINE is the primary source of truth
Pionex WebSocket order-book activity remains automatic fallback
Pionex RWA status is derived from future_markets contract tags
trade_time_7_24 renders as 7×24
trade_time_5_7 / 5_24 / delayed-open rules are evaluated from market_customized trade_time_config
R2 caches Pionex trade rules for 6 hours; one cache object is overwritten
Embedded Pionex rule seed prevents blank status if the internal web API is temporarily unavailable
Previous WebSocket activity guessing is no longer used for market-open/closed state
